notes: The on-disk point-in-time ladder ledger — one newline-JSON file per series under <data root>/history/predexon_l2_pit/ (Kalshi pulls AND the Polymarket backfill share the layout, so ONE source imports both venues; the venue is read off the series prefix downstream, never declared here). Imported through the generic localtables connector: every row is a decision epoch (event_ticker, contract_ticker, kind lead|settle, lead_frac, epoch_ts_ms, book_json, admissible, quality_ok, usable, ...). `stamp_stem_as` writes the file stem — the series — onto each row; a row already carrying a different `series` refuses, so a misfiled ledger cannot enter silently. The instant is epoch_ts_ms in epoch milliseconds, hence `effective_unit: ms`. Register with: python -m dskit.onboarding register-source pit_ladders --connector localtables --config @configs/source-pit-ladders.json --catalog-source <P1 source> --activate; then acquire --mode backfill. Change `path` to your data root; nothing else is machine-specific.
